v.1: Celebrate the Name of your Lord, the Most Exalted,
v.5: and then turned it into a black scum.
v.6: We shall have you recite [the Quran], then you will not forget [any of it]
v.7: except what Allah may wish. Indeed, He knows the open and what is hidden.
v.8: And We shall ease you into facility.
v.9: So admonish, for admonition is indeed beneficial:
v.10: he who fears [God] will take admonition,
v.11: and the most wretched will shun it
v.12: —he who will enter the Great Fire,
v.13: then he will neither live in it, nor die.
v.15: celebrates the Name of his Lord, and prays.
v.16: But you prefer the life of this world,
v.17: while the Hereafter is better and more lasting.’
v.18: This is indeed in the former scriptures,
v.19: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
